mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a single meeting signals a hawkish monetary policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% in a single meeting
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% in a single meeting.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 declines and CPIAUCSL increases.
